name: AccessUN (Readex index to UN documents and publications)
description: Commercial bibliographic index to UN documents and publications, historically a finding aid for the Readex UN microfiche collection with links to full text on UN websites.
institutional_access_note: Was available by institutional subscription; current availability uncertain.
found_via: Guide: Harvard University (https://guides.library.harvard.edu/gov/ir); Guide: University of Southern California (https://libguides.usc.edu/IR/Crime)

name: ACE Electoral Knowledge Network: Electoral Materials library and Election Observation Portal
provider: ACE Electoral Knowledge Network (partnership of electoral-assistance organizations including International IDEA and IFES)
description: A continuously expanded virtual library of electoral documents from countries worldwide (ballot papers, constitutions and electoral laws, observation reports, codes of conduct, handbooks, training manuals, forms and posters), searchable by language, topic, country and document type, with country pages gathering observation reports from many organizations.
institutional_access_note: Free online; no subscription. The linked Election Observation Portal (aceproject.org/electoral-advice/dop/mob-dop) returned HTTP 503 when checked on 2026-11-03.
found_via: Guide: Princeton University (https://libguides.princeton.edu/elections/foreign); Guide: University of Southern California (https://libguides.usc.edu/IR/Elections); Guide: Sciences Po (Fondation Nationale des Sciences Politiques) (https://sciencespo.libguides.com/science-politique/donnees_officielles-institutions-comportements_politique); Guide: University of Essex (https://library.essex.ac.uk/politics/elections)
